description.narrative: El objetivo general de la primera operacin individual bajo la CCLIP es promover mejoras de productividad a travs del fomento de la inversin en innovacin. Los objetivos especficos son: (i) incrementar la inversin en innovacin de empresas en sectores prioritarios; (ii) aumentar la adopcin de tecnologas en Micro, Pequeas y Medianas empresas (MiPyMes) con potencial innovador; (iii) facilitar el crecimiento de emprendimientos dinmicos; y (iv) fortalecer las capacidades institucionales de Finep para el diseo, monitoreo y evaluacin de proyectos estratgicos.

The overall objective of the first individual operation under the CCLIP is to promote productivity improvements through the promotion of investment in innovation. The specific objectives are: (i) to increase the investment in innovation of companies in priority sectors; (Ii) to increase the adoption of technologies in Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MiPyMes) with innovative potential; (Iii) facilitate the growth of dynamic ventures; And (iv) strengthen Finep's institutional capacities for the design, monitoring and evaluation of strategic projects.
